records.title: MANUFACTURING 500 VANDE BHARAT TRAINS.
details: a to d: At Present, 10 Vande Bharat Sleeper trains are under production.

records.title: Land for BHEL
details: Approximately 216 Acres of land in BHEL, Bhopal are currently under unauthorised encroachment. For the removal of encroachment, BHEL has repeatedly taken up the matter with State Authorities.
